title: CustomTP
description: Save and teleport to custom locations.
body:
**CustomTP – Teleportation Made Simple**

CustomTP is a lightweight Minecraft Fabric mod that allows players to save and teleport to custom locations in their world with ease. Perfect for survival, creative building, or large multiplayer servers, CustomTP gives you full control over teleport points without relying on external tools.

**Features:**

Save your favorite locations with a custom name.
Instantly teleport to any saved location.
List all saved locations.
Remove locations you no longer need.

**Commands:**

/ctp save <name> – Saves your current location under the given name.
/ctp tp <name> – Teleports you to the saved location.
/ctp list – Displays all saved locations.
/ctp remove <name> – Deletes a saved location.
/ctp loc <player> – Shows how far you are (in blocks) from the nearest saved location.
**Usage:**

Walk to a spot you want to remember.
Use /ctp save home (or any name you prefer).
Teleport anytime using /ctp tp home.
Manage saved locations with /ctp list and /ctp remove <name>.
Check your distance to the nearest saved location with /ctp loc <player>.

**Dependencies:**

Minecraft 1.20.1
Fabric Loader 0.17.3 or above
Fabric API
